sections.title: Section I — No Calculator
sections.notes: No calculator allowed for this section.

sections.title: Section II — Calculator Permitted
sections.notes: A calculator may be used for this section.

pool.text: When \( f(x) = x^3 - 2x + 5 \) is divided by \( (x - 2) \), what is the remainder?
pool.sol: \( f(2) = 8 - 4 + 5 = 9 \). (Remainder Theorem)

pool.text: Evaluate \( \log_2 32 \).
pool.sol: \( 2^5 = 32 \Rightarrow \log_2 32 = 5 \).

pool.text: Find the sum to infinity of \( 9 + 3 + 1 + \cdots \)
Simplify \( (2 + 3i)(1 - 2i) \).
The table shows terms of a geometric sequence. Find the common ratio and the 6th term.
Which identity is correct?
pool.sol: Pythagorean identity: \( 1 + \tan^2\theta = \sec^2\theta \Rightarrow \sec^2\theta - 1 = \tan^2\theta \).

pool.text: An arithmetic sequence has first term \( a_1 = 5 \) and common difference \( d = 4 \). Find the sum of the first 15 terms. Show all working.
Longitudinal oscillator #7 operates under the relation the nonlinear transfer function \( f(x) = 2x^2 - 9 \). What is the value of \( f(6) \)?
What is the domain of \( f(x) = \ln(x - 3) \)?
pool.sol: Argument must be positive: \( x - 3 > 0 \Rightarrow x > 3 \).

pool.text: What is the equation of the circle with centre \( (-2,\,3) \) and radius 4?
The table shows exam marks for 20 students. Find the mean and identify the modal class.
Prove the identity: \( \dfrac{\sin^2\theta}{1 - \cos\theta} = 1 + \cos\theta \). Show all steps.
pool.sol: \[ \dfrac{1-\cos^2\theta}{1-\cos\theta} = \dfrac{(1-\cos\theta)(1+\cos\theta)}{1-\cos\theta} = 1+\cos\theta. \; \checkmark \]

pool.text: What is \( \cos(180^\circ - x) \)?
pool.sol: \( \cos(180^\circ - x) = -\cos x \). (supplementary angle identity)

pool.text: In how many ways can the letters of the word MATH be arranged?

pool.sol: \( P(A\cap B) = P(B|A)\cdot P(A) = 0.5 \times 0.4 = 0.2 \).

pool.text: Solve \( e^{2x} = 10 \) exactly.
pool.sol: \( 2x = \ln 10 \Rightarrow x = \dfrac{\ln 10}{2} \).

pool.text: A circle has equation \( x^2 + y^2 - 6x + 4y - 12 = 0 \). Find the centre and radius by completing the square. Show all steps.
In the expansion of \( (x + 2)^5 \), what is the coefficient of \( x^3 \)?

pool.sol: \( 2^{3x} = 2^{4(x-1)} \Rightarrow 3x = 4x - 4 \Rightarrow x = 4 \).

pool.sol: \[ A = \tfrac{1}{2} \cdot 6 \cdot 8 \cdot \sin 30^\circ = 24 \times \tfrac{1}{2} = 12. \]
